attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared writable directory with mode 1777 (world read/write/execute + sticky bit), owned by root:root. Verified functionally with two separate unprivileged users: both could write files into the directory, but only the file owner (not another user) could delete a file, matching sticky-bit semantics. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via native `reboot`, polled until reconnection, confirmed a changed boot_id (new boot), and re-verified both the directory permissions and the cross-user delete-restriction behavior post-reboot were unchanged. All test users and files were cleaned up, leaving /srv/drop empty.
